description: Deployment manifest only. No rules have been applied to the Cloudflare zone.

mediaAccess.expression: (http.host eq "store-media.vrclearn.com" and (ip.src.country in {"XX" "T1"} or (ip.src.country eq "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cn/")) or (ip.src.country ne "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/intl/"))))

emergencyDynamicStop.expression: (http.host eq "store.vrclearn.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path contains "/products/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/shops/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/sitemap.xml" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sitemaps/")))
